# Resource: tfe_opa_version

Manages OPA versions available on Terraform Enterprise.

-> **Note:** You can fetch an OPA version ID from the URL of an existing version in the HCP Terraform UI. The ID is in the format `tool-<RANDOM STRING>`.

## Example Usage

```go
import constructs "github.com/aws/constructs-go/constructs"
import cdktf "github.com/hashicorp/terraform-cdk-go/cdktf"
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/opaVersion"
type myConvertedCode struct {
	TerraformStack
}

func newMyConvertedCode(scope Construct, name *string) *myConvertedCode {
	this := &myConvertedCode{}
	cdktf.NewTerraformStack_Override(this, scope, name)
	opaVersion.NewOpaVersion(this, jsii.String("test"), &OpaVersionConfig{
		sha: jsii.String("e75ac73deb69a6b3aa667cb0b8b731aee79e2904"),
		url: jsii.String("https://tfe-host.com/path/to/opa"),
		version: jsii.String("0.58.0-custom"),
	})
	return this
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Version` (String) A semantic version string in N.N.N or N.N.N-bundleName format.

### Optional

- `Archs` (Attributes Set) A list of architecture-specific binaries for this OPA version. When specifying architecture-specific binaries, the top-level `Url` and `Sha` attributes are deprecated and should not be used. If both top-level `Url` and `Sha` are specified, an `Archs` entry for the `Amd64` architecture must also be included, and its `Url` and `Sha` values must match the top-level values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--archs))
- `Beta` (Boolean) Whether or not this version of OPA is beta pre-release. Defaults to `False`.
- `Deprecated` (Boolean) Whether or not this version of OPA is deprecated. Defaults to `False`.
- `DeprecatedReason` (String) Additional context about why a version of OPA is deprecated. Defaults to `Null` unless `Deprecated` is `True`.
- `Enabled` (Boolean) Whether or not this version of OPA is enabled for use in HCP Terraform and Terraform Enterprise. Defaults to `True`.
- `Official` (Boolean) Whether or not this is an official release of OPA. Defaults to `False`.
- `Sha` (String) The SHA-256 checksum of the compressed OPA binary. Soon to be deprecated, use `Archs` instead.
- `Url` (String) The URL where a 64-bit Linux binary of this version can be downloaded. Soon to be deprecated, use `Archs` instead.

### Read-Only

- `Id` (String) The ID of the OPA version.

<a id="nestedatt--archs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `Archs`

Required:

- `Arch` (String) The architecture for which this binary is intended.
- `Os` (String) The operating system for which this binary is intended.
- `Sha` (String) The SHA-256 checksum of the compressed binary.
- `Url` (String) The URL where a ZIP-compressed binary of this version can be downloaded.




## Import

Resource tfe_opa_version can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <OPA VERSION ID>
terraform import tfe_opa_version.test tool-L4oe7rNwn7J4E5Yr

# via <OPA VERSION NUMBER>
terraform import tfe_opa_version.test 0.58.0
```
